title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：proposal　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proposal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the clerk ① made the proposal that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the making was the whole of the month. The ② proposal, meaning the plan itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a proposal, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ proposal in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ proposal at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A proposal, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the proposal was the whole of the matter, meaning the intention and not the plan. The ⑥ proposal, meaning the intention and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; proposal, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a plan and an intention. He said the intention is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ proposal had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ proposal of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; proposal, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ proposal I remember is the plan noted in the file, which closed in 2001 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ proposal, my mother said in 2003, is the only plan that improves by being noted; every proposal, she said, is an intention that has agreed to look like a plan. She said the intention was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 提议；提案（指办事处里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 提议；提案（指那项提议本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the proposal 提出这一项提议
D. n. 提议；提案（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 提议之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的提议之事）
F. n. 提议；提案（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一项）
G. n. 提议、心意（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心意（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the proposal that no applicant in the office would have noted

the proposal at the far counter

answers.why: make the proposal 意为“提出这一项提议”，1994 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一项提议做了一遍。
proposal 意为“提议；提案”，指那项提议本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
proposal 意为“提议；提案”，指办事处里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
proposal 意为“提议；提案”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
proposal 意为“提议、心意”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项心意就是那件事的全部。
proposal 意为“心意”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项提议，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
proposal 意为“提议；提案”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一项，到 1999 年这一项成了卷宗里的一行。
proposal 意为“提议之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的提议之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
proposal 意为“提议；提案”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一项，2001 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一项。
proposal 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，提议是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的提议。
